titulo: Europe Today: EU's economy chief Dombrovskis on Euronews as 9/11 attacks mark 25 years
cuerpo: Twenty-five years after the September 11 attacks, we report on how this event changed America and the world. Also on the show: exclusive interviews with the EU's economy chief Valdis Dombrovskis, Norway's FM Espen Barth Eide, and Brazil's Ambassador to the EU Pedro Miguel da Costa e Silva.
